extensionDescription.message: Select, review and bulk delete chats in ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini. Local, free and without tracking.

popupIntro.message: Fewer chats. More clarity. Select chats in ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini and review them before deleting them together.

popupNote.message: For chatgpt.com, claude.ai and gemini.google.com. No third-party account, no telemetry.

popupUnavailable.message: Please open ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini in your browser and reload the tab once. Then try again.

geminiDeletionNote.message: In Gemini, this also deletes related activity and content created in the chat, such as Canvas documents.

deletionNote.message: Only the selected chats in your account will be deleted.

scopeLoaded.message: Loaded chats outside the screen also get checkboxes. Chats that have not loaded yet appear after scrolling; new entries start unselected.

scopeCodex.message: Codex tasks in ChatGPT history can also be selected. They are marked as Codex tasks in the deletion preview.

scopeHidden.message: Open collapsed groups yourself first. Closed projects, archives and search results are not searched. Chats that cannot be identified clearly do not get a checkbox.

busyNote.message: Keep this tab open. Do not reload or navigate to another page until the process has finished. Stopping prevents further deletions. A deletion already confirmed may still finish.

ready.message: Ready. You review your selection before deleting.

reviewKeepTab.message: Keep this tab open while deleting. Do not reload or navigate to another page until the process has finished.

rangeHint.message: Select a range: click the first checkbox, then hold Shift and click the checkbox at the other end.

reviewUnavailable.message: Currently not loaded or changed – load it again or remove it.

emptySelection.message: The selection is empty. Choose Cancel to return to the chat list.

loadingProgress.message: Scrolling the sidebar. Each pass takes at most 30 seconds.

loadLimit.message: Time or step limit reached. You can load more again.

loadNoMore.message: No more entries detected for now. Load more again if needed.

loadingStopped.message: Loading stopped. Your selection is kept.

reviewWarning.message: These chats will be deleted from your $provider$ account. This cannot be undone.

noChats.message: No chats detected yet. Open the $provider$ sidebar and your history. Unrecognized entries will not be deleted.

unavailableCount.message: $count$ selected chats are currently unavailable or changed. Scroll back or remove them in the preview.

deletionStopped.message:
Stopped. $done$ of $total$ operations observed. Please check your history.
$error$

loadingDone.message: Loading finished: $count$ more chats detected. $detail$ This does not confirm that the entire history is loaded.

errorScrollList.message: No unambiguous scrollable chat list detected. Open the sidebar and scroll it manually.

errorListChanged.message: The chat list has changed. Please open it again.

errorCloseOverlays.message: Please close open menus or dialogs first.

errorVirtualized.message: The page hides chats while scrolling. Work in smaller groups; your selection is kept.

errorBoundTarget.message: The selected chat changed during confirmation. Please select it again.

errorReappeared.message: A chat already processed has reappeared in the history. Please check your history.

errorMultipleMenus.message: Multiple menus detected; the association is ambiguous.

errorMenuMissing.message: The chat menu was not detected.

errorMenuChanged.message: The open chat menu changed while its association was being checked.

errorMenuUnbound.message: The open menu cannot be clearly linked to the selected chat.

errorDeleteAction.message: The Delete menu item could not be clearly identified. The interface does not provide an unambiguous delete action.

errorMenuIdentity.message: The delete menu item does not confirm the selected chat ID.

errorDeleteDisabled.message: The delete menu item is disabled.

errorResultMissing.message: The deletion dialog or result was not detected. Check your history before starting again.

errorDialogChanged.message: The confirmation dialog changed while it was loading.

errorDialogIncomplete.message: The deletion dialog did not finish loading. Please check your history.

errorConfirmation.message: The deletion confirmation is not unambiguously available.

errorResultUnclear.message: The result of the last deletion is unclear. Reload the page and check your history; no automatic retry will be made.

errorPreflight.message: The selection is not fully available or has changed: “$title$”. Nothing has been deleted yet. Load the chat back into the sidebar or remove it from the selection.

errorTargetMissing.message: “$title$” is no longer in the loaded sidebar. Please select it again.

errorTitleChanged.message: The title of “$title$” has changed. Please select it again.

errorProviderAlert.message: $provider$ reported a notice or error. Please check your history.

errorProviderOverlays.message: Please close open $provider$ dialogs and menus first.

errorDialogIdentity.message: The deletion dialog does not clearly confirm “$title$”. No further chats will be deleted.
